No builder report, completion report, or acceptance packet was read as evidence at any point; the builder's coordinating messages were used only to locate the subject and to learn which commits to freeze. It is raised here rather than left for a reader to discover.

clarity_coverage_regressed.detail: This witness's pass-1 finding was wrong and is retracted. scripts/sov_clarity.py do_record writes 'changed' from an explicit --changed CLI flag, so it records whether a completed review edited the artifact; it is not a drift flag and nothing consumes it as a review queue. Drift is TEXT_STALE and BASIS_STALE, computed from artifact and basis digests by state_map and failed by do_check. That gate is real, passes clean at b93a721, and fires: appending an unreviewed sentence to GROUND.md yields STALE lines and exit 1, and reaches verify.py through the repository tooling tests. The pass-1 inference that regenerating coverage.json silently re-baselines basis digests is also retracted; do_record acts on one path per explicit invocation, so the CANON.md and CONTRACT.md flips record reviews that were actually performed. The builder's reading was correct and this witness's was not.

findings: F1 RESOLVED. Dead population: verification-checks derived 55 and bound zero claims while the run reported it as coverage. Removed, recorded under owned_elsewhere, owner verified to fire.

F2 RESOLVED IN PART, HONESTLY SCOPED. The selfcheck's stated purpose exceeded what it proved. A binding case now closes global scanner decay and the docstring retracts the over-promise. A single population going dormant still exits 0; it is printed by name rather than silent.
F3 RESOLVED. 'of the' in subset_qualifiers suppressed three sentences stating a manifest total exactly, while preventing no false drift. Removed; three claims gained, all MATCH.

F4 RECORDED, NOT CLOSED. The historical exemption key (path, anchor, stated) covers any live claim in the same file stating the same number about the same population. A planted present-tense 'the repository holds 17 decision records' against a record of 90 is reported HISTORICAL, citing L-0001's unrelated reason, and passes. Now named in not_settled with the witness's planted case; the hole itself remains, by a defensible design choice against line numbers.
F5 RESOLVED. PRD.md:507 repaired the denominator without re-deriving the numerator. The predicate is now explicit and four is correct under it.
F6 RETRACTED. The clarity 'changed' finding was this witness's error. See predicate clarity_coverage_regressed.
F7 RESOLVED. The capability map is now re-derived from the manifests inside verify, with a live defeating case.
F8 NOT A DEFECT. The tooling assertion rewrite asserted a sounder property; the old instrument was genuinely brittle.

F9 OPEN, LOW. The contract's own 'five live places across four documents' is wrong; eight graded sites across six files. A hand-written count inside the counted-populations contract, graded by nothing.

F10 OPEN, LOW. scripts/tests/test_sov_counts.py test_matches_counts_a_document_the_repository_enumerates asserts 16 against live GROUND.md. Adding a legitimate GROUND-017 fails that test, which is a hand-written count with no counter inside the suite built to eliminate them. A fixture or an independently derived expectation would remove it.

F11 OPEN, MEDIUM. No instrument measures the guard lists. 15 of 16 threshold words and 11 of 12 subset words currently cost nothing and prevent nothing; each will silently suppress the first genuine total it ever prefixes, and only the per-word method used in this witness would notice. A test asserting that every guard word either prevents a DRIFT or costs nothing is cheap, would have caught 'of the' automatically, and is the generalisation of F3.

F12 OPEN, LOW. A writer can escape grading by prefixing a guard word, turning a census into a bound or a part in wording only. The contract names the guard going short but not this opposite direction.

F13 OBSERVATION. contracts/participant-observation.schema.json forbids additional top-level properties, while scripts/sov_land.py _report reads observation['observer_id'] and observation['verdict'] and scripts/sovland/candidates.py reads candidate_commit, candidate_tree and base_commit at top level. Every landed record, including this one, places them inside observed, so the gate's display line reads None. A gate reading fields its own schema forbids; not this concern's to repair.
